title: Doc Eon
summary: An Etherite inventor said to have come from the future.

claims.text: Doc Eon left behind several devices, among them a highly vulgar machine that winds time back a moment while everyone keeps the memory of what happened.
Doc Eon went back into the future, where some say the inventor came from in the first place.

title: Etherite heroes in effigy
summary: Famous names of the Sons of Ether, as shown in a trapped exhibit.

claims.text: An Etherite exhibit of heroes shows Czar Vargo and the Etherships, Colonel Arno Valiant's deep-space balloon team, Professor Thunder with a tyrannosaur, Lorenzo Golo and Baron Brimstone fighting Garou in the Wild West.
Each figure is also a trap that punishes visitors who seem hostile or Technocratic.

title: Dr. Paulinus Mercer
summary: A violinist whose 1907 Paris concert with Isadora Duncan bent reality.

claims.text: In 1907 Mercer played while the Ecstatic dancer Isadora Duncan performed in Paris; witnesses saw the hall flicker into a Greek temple and the light of Olympus, and some of the crowd went mad or rioted.
The police stopped the pair from performing in public again, but they caused a sensation in the smoking rooms of the first Sons of Ether.

title: Rolling Thunder's Mini-vac
summary: A Dreamspeaker device for trapping small spirits.

claims.text: Rolling Thunder built the Mini-vac in a Minnesota cabin and uses it to catch troublesome minor spirits and release them where they can do no harm.
The Tradition's elders disapprove and treat the few copies in circulation as banned; against strong spirits the device only angers them.
